Results.ReviewText: I have the first series of performer grill, so it's over 25 years old. I'm pressed to fit everything I have to cook and than I realized I had four Weber kettle grills to take care of the whole meal in the past. But gave them away. I was looking at gravity fed charcoal grills, hoping Weber would come out with one, but that is not going to happen since they came out with temp control models. I just went out and bought a new Weber kettle and I'm very happy now and have all the room to cook for family gatherings. I have a Weber gas grill that is over 35 years old with the original igniter. I have only had to replace favorizer bars and shore up the cart.

Results.ReviewText: I owned a Weber spirit propane grill several years ago that I loved. However I’ve always wanted to get a charcoal grill and finally did about a month back. This grill exceeds all expectations. It’s easy to use and clean and the flavor it provides to food is incredible. My kids are already requesting I cook every meal “on the blue grill” after just a few cooks.

Photos.Caption: The summer I bought my first Weber kettle will undoubtedly go down as one of the best summers of my life!

Results.ReviewText: So happy I decided to buy a kettle versus a gas grill; I enjoy and take pride in the food I’ve prepared. I didn’t know it was possible for me to make this quality of food at home. I still don’t quite understand why anyone would want to own a gas grill, but that’s just me. I’ve had it for a few months now and I’ve cooked burgers, chicken, chops, brisket… I’m smoking some pork belly as I type this. This little thing is a beast. 10/10 recommend if you want to actually have a hands-on cooking experience and take pride in your food.
Results.Title: There’s no turning back now— I’m a grill dad.

Results.ReviewText: Updated grill grates, better wheel base which gives it a slightly higher grilling level and of course the side lid now has a proper spot. Really nice grill that can do all types of cooking. Support form Weber as well as an assortment of accessories available makes it a worthy addition.
Results.Title: Classic Weber but Better

Results.ReviewText: My 22" Master Touch kettle has been a great addition to my cooking routine. I have used the coal divider for two zone cooking and the elevated rack for warming buns. Additionally, I have purchased Weber Charcoal baskets and the Weber temperature controlled, which is a heat deflecting insert. I really like the added height of the Master Touch over my 20 year old 18" Weber kettle, which is still in excellent condition, despite being outside and uncovered all that time in the California sun.  I also like the heft of the grill and that the edges open up to add wood for smoking. The only thing I am not crazy about is that the center section comes out from the rest of the grill. I understand this is for using cast iron accessories, but I haven't used anything like that, and it makes it so I can't hang the grill on the side of the kettle when needed. Not a big deal. I am learning the art of temperature control using the vents, and I have had good results using the "snake method " with the Weber temperature controller heat defuser for low and slow smoking.  All I need now is an internal meat thermometer and I will be set!  I am very pleased with my purchase.
Results.Title: Weber Master Touch Kettle Grill? Absolutely!

Results.ReviewText: The grill is ok. Lid does not fit properly all the way around. The wheels are not what was pictured. Instead they had black mag snap in covers. The grill with the removable center could be nice for attachments, but it's more of a hassle than it's worth to me. It falls out too easy and is hard to align in place on a hot grill after you've put the coals in. I do like to lid holder. The paint is pretty decent too.

Results.ReviewText: Its just a really good charcoal grill. I now have a Weber gas grill and charcoal grill and both are excellent.

Results.ReviewText: I am a huge Weber fan. I've had nothing but Weber grills in my life. My new Weber Touch grill has been great except for one item. I dislike the lid bail. I think it's the design of the metal "hoop" I believe it's too small. My lid hangs over the grill at an angle and somewhat gets in the way. I wish it had that hook that my old Weber kettle had.

Results.ReviewText: I had been using a full sized pellet grill for 8 years and finally got tired of the mechanical mishaps and inability to grill / sear after the slow cook. The Weber grill has been able to do both without the need for a motor, augur, and difficult to reach areas to clean. I think there are some design improvements that could be made to the Weber, but it is hard to beat its capabilities for the price.

Results.ReviewText: We purchased this barbeque grill so we can cook and customize the flavors with different types of charcoal. We like the special features especially the ability to dispose of the used charcoal and the special top that allows you to hold the top in the upright position.
Results.Title: Best charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Great product, i have been using Weber kettle grills for more than 30 years. Its a grill that works. There is not a grill in its price range that can match it ability to cook low and slow or sear a steak.
Results.Title: A grill that works

Results.ReviewText: I still have my original kettle however,  for father's day my family bought the upgraded kettle. The higher stance is a big help, the lid holder is also a reason for buying this grill.
Results.Title: Another winner

Results.ReviewText: The added features on this grill are nice and useful upgrades from my original Weber.  Love the grill!
Results.Title: Nice Upgrade

Results.ReviewText: A great grill that helped me elevate my grilling and smoking skills! Great quality and value for money.
Results.Title: A great grill and smoker

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely love the 22" Master-Touch. Easy to control the temperature. Works well for both direct and indirect grilling. It wakes grilling with charcoal a dream.
Results.Title: Love My Weber 22" Master-Touch

Results.ReviewText: I have been looking at Weber for a while.  Over the years I went with 2 other brands, and then finally turned to the Master-Touch Grill.  It performs very well and is so easy to empty ashes.  I don't know why I didn't do this sooner.
Results.Title: Finally!

Results.ReviewText: This is a great  BBQ/Grill kettle. Weber's materials are strong, durable, and last a long time. Doesn't need a lot of bells and whistles as it is quite adapatable to hot and fast, low and slow, and everything in between as to cooking temperatures.

Results.ReviewText:
I purchased the Weber Master-Touch 22 after my previous grill names after the little French emperor had reached the end of its life. I decided to give Weber a try because I had heard good things about the brand, and as an experienced BBQ enthusiast, I was genuinely looking forward to using it. I especially enjoy South American-style BBQ, so I have fairly high expectations when it comes to charcoal grilling.

Unfortunately, my experience with this grill has been extremely disappointing.

My biggest issue is the shallow cooking depth and the fact that the cooking grate cannot be adjusted in height. With the way I like to cook, this makes it very difficult to control the heat and distance from the charcoal. Almost everything I cook ends up getting deeply burned, even when I carefully manage the charcoal.

Controlling the amount and placement of charcoal to achieve the right cooking temperature is also much harder than I expected. For someone who has been BBQing for years, I find the lack of control particularly frustrating.

I really wanted to like this grill, but I am having a terrible time with it. I am deeply disappointed with the Weber Master-Touch 22 and honestly wish I had never purchased it.
Results.Title: Master touch 22

I absolutely love my 22-inch Master-Touch Charcoal Grill and highly recommend it! It is well designed, easy to use, and makes grilling a pleasure.

While assembling it, I noticed that one wing nut was missing. I contacted customer service, and they helped me right away. They shipped the missing part, and I received it within two days. Excellent product and outstanding customer service!

Not really impressed. The legs for the unit are cheap. Most of them didn’t fit. Had to lube them to fit. The included ‘wrench’ couldn’t get the bits on the bolts even halfway through. Use normal sockets. 
The assembly instructions suck. There are still two parts of the grill that are shown in the assembly manual that I can’t figure out how they install not to mention what their function is.

After two uses, one of the nuts that holds the handle onto the lid already got too hot and fell off, or I'm really not sure. The other one is holding fine, but the first one melted and fell out. Overall, I'm generally happy, but this was a surprising issue.

I probably need to do a warranty claim.

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
